name: Jötunn

frame.name: Charge Shot
frame.description: Hold down the trigger to charge up a tracking shot that explodes and burns on impact.

perks.name: Volatile Launch
perks.description:
This weapon is optimized for an especially explosive payload.
  •  Greatly increases blast radius
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed
  •  Slightly decreases projectile speed

perks.name: Liquid Coils
perks.description:
Slower-building charge for higher damage.
  •  Increases impact damage
  •  Slower charge time

perks.name: Shield Disorient
perks.description: Energy matched shield explosion disorients nearby combatants.

perks.name: Polymer Grip
perks.description:
This weapon's grip is made of lighter material.
  •  Increases handling speed

flavor: "Untamed. Destructive. As forceful and chaotic as Ymir himself." —Ada-1

catalyst.name: Jötunn Catalyst
catalyst.description:
Faster charge time or draw time when surrounded by combatants.
Defeating a target spreads scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.
